name: Christopher 'Kit' Williams
style: Traditional oil-painting techniques, fashioning first a wooden panel covered in linen and oil gesso, using many layers of opaque and transparent Dutch oil paint to create luminous images, making his own frames which enables him to make pictures of any shape and allow elements of the picture to continue into the frame in often intricate detail
theme: Figurative art, often with moving elements within the frame or the painting that encourage interaction by the viewer
